title: LIN-4254 piece 1: sessions/app suites onto loadWorld (lin-3254, lin-4016, both lin-4024)
description:
**Piece 1 of LIN-4254: the sessions/app group.** Lands after Piece 0. These pieces are sequential because every one edits `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES`.

## Implemented (stub; the slice and the 21:35 loader call are discharged)

Implemented as approved, with the person's 21:35 loader call and the 08:07 ruling applied: the four suites (`lin-3254-session-run-toggles`, `lin-4016-sessions-fold-parked`, `lin-4024-look`, `lin-4024-home-description`) run on `loadWorld` with their `vm` sandboxes deleted and are off `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (census 22 -> 18). `loadWorld`'s `window` is now the global object, `clickOn(element, target)` / `clickDelegated(target)` / `fireDOMContentLoaded` were added to `client-world.js`, and `lin-3254` runs over `renderSessionPage` markup. The `laneNode` export moved to LIN-4310. Merged in [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2322](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2322>) (squash `f73f1b11`). Full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

## Acceptance

* Each file is either on `loadWorld` with its sandbox gone and its census entry removed, or still listed with a true stop comment (API + `file:line`).
* Test names and counts are preserved (sorted-name diff in the PR).
* Newly red tests are classified and listed.
* Census, line budget and the full unit suite are green.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4254 (Move the 16 not-attempted client-test stubs onto the shared fake). This piece's starting point is the parent's approved **Implementation Plan** in LIN-4254's description, plus the builder notes in its approving Plan Review Verdict (comment `c1d9a66c-fb1a-4f25-903c-e11227c24ba7`). Follow it. Where the code shows it wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4254.

**Rules for every piece (from the plan):** "Moved" means the suite runs on `loadWorld` (`tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js` over `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`) and its private `vm.createContext` sandbox is deleted. Do not wrap the old sandbox around the fake. Slices and scripts that query the DOM at load use `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })`, then `parse(markup, document.body)`, then `world.run(source)`, as `observation-ruling-delivery` and LIN-4284 do. Router markup comes from the server's real renderer where one exists, not from hand-written HTML. Do not widen the fake. A file that hits an API the fake does not model (a `FakeDomError`, a `style` or layout read, or an unmodelled method such as `click()`) stays on `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` with a `// stop:` comment naming the API and `file:line`. A `querySelector: () => null` stub that becomes a real tree can bring dead paths to life. A test that goes red there is a finding: classify it as a real client bug, a vacuous pass or a fake gap, and list it in the PR. Never loosen the test. Test names are kept. Do not split a file to keep a count, and do not copy a fixture.

**Testing strategy (every move PR):** an assertion map; before/after sorted test names, diffed against base; one mutation per load-bearing assertion, showing it goes red; and green runs of `fake-dom-census.test.js`, `claude-md-line-budget.test.js` and the full unit suite. The census count only falls. Every remaining entry's reason is true at merge.

**Grounding commits:** plan and approving review at `b581ac92` (Surveys at `b581ac926`); LIN-4292 landed as `b389f9b0`. Re-check `git log b581ac92..origin/main -- tests/unit public` before starting.

**Session fit:** fits one session
**Plan-review due:** no — covered by LIN-4254's approving plan-review (comment c1d9a66c-fb1a-4f25-903c-e11227c24ba7, rev 2)

comments.body:
**LIN-4307 PR is open: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2322** (branch `feat/lin-4307-sessions-app-loadworld`, commit `fbd00503`).

**Done:** `lin-3254-session-run-toggles`, `lin-4016-sessions-fold-parked`, `lin-4024-look` and `lin-4024-home-description` are on `loadWorld`, with their vm sandboxes deleted. All four are removed from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (census 22 → 18). The home-description suite uses the server's own Home markup, with no stand-in for document or window.
- Test names are identical to base, checked by sorted-name diff.
- Five mutations each turn their guarding test red (`public/` restored after each).
- Green: unit suite (23,837 pass), `test:hermetic:keyed`, `test:hermetic:proxy`, secret scan.

**Not done, two of the four loader fixes from the 21:35 call:**
1. **`window` as the global object: held back.** `observation-ruling-delivery.test.js` `makeSandbox` stubs the bare `relativeTime` at :177 and then runs the real `common.js` at :210. `common.js:575` sets `window.relativeTime`, which replaces the stub under the global model. Needs a decision: fix that suite's stub order, or keep the separate-copy model. The four suites here don't depend on it.
2. **`laneNode` export: deferred to LIN-4310 (piece 4).** It closes over `reducedMotion` and `updateLaneNode` inside an IIFE, so exporting it means a new `window` global in `public/live-console.js`. No piece-1 suite needs it, and its only consumer is `task-page-link-client-surfaces`.

`requestAnimationFrame` and `__LIVE_CONSOLE_DATA__` were already in `live-console-world.js`.

**Shared helper, additive:** `clickOn(element, target)`, `clickDelegated(target)` and `fireDOMContentLoaded(document)` in `client-world.js`, pinned in `client-world.test.js`.

**CI:** checks are running on the PR; this comment will be followed by the result.

CI on PR #2322 (https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2322, commit fbd00503) is green: Unit tests, all four E2E shards, Secret scan, and CI success. Mergeable (CLEAN). Merge and review are not done by this task.

## Review — LIN-4307

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2322 at head `fbd00503`. Its merge-base is `165c61e7`, which is current `origin/main`. Nothing has landed under `tests/unit`, `public` or `lib` since the ticket was created except piece 0 (`165c61e7`) and LIN-4304 (`f742e5ac`), and the branch is built on both.

CI: green on `fbd00503`. Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and CI success all pass. The PR is MERGEABLE.

### What I checked
- **Test names:** I ran the 4 moved suites plus `client-world`, `fake-dom-census` and `claude-md-line-budget` on head and on `origin/main` in a separate worktree, then diffed the sorted names. Base has 92 names and head has 96. The only differences are the 4 added `client-world.test.js` names (3 tests plus their `describe`). Nothing was renamed or lost. On head: 81/81 pass.
- **Sandboxes:** each moved file has no `vm` import left, and none wraps a sandbox around the fake. All four are off `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES`, so the census drops from 22 to 18 and is green.
- **Mutations:** every one went red, and `public/` and the helper were restored after each (`git status` clean):
  - `session.js:88` without `.sess-proposals` → `lin-3254` test 1 red.
  - `session.js:88` without `.sess-inline-reply` → test 2 red.
  - `toggleRun` without the `aria-expanded` write → red.
  - `app.js:1308` without the `!home.dataset.rendered` guard → home-description red.
  - `app.js:1306` with the description branch disabled → red.
  - `app.js:1271` without the show-more `rendered` guard → red.
  - `app.js:1271` with show-more never rendering → red.
  - `sessions.js` `stateWord = ''` → `lin-4016` red and `lin-4024-look` red.
  - `mountHomePromptSections` with `id` forced to null → `look` red.
  - `clickDelegated` sending to the target's own listeners → home-description red (2 tests).
  - `clickOn` ignoring `target` → `lin-3254` red (2 tests).
- **Real markup is now in use:** `lin-4024-look` mounts the server's real `[data-prompt-mount]` placeholders (`renderDetailsContent`, home layout) through `document`, where it used to use a `querySelectorAll: () => rows` stub. `lin-4024-home-description` uses the server's fold and show-more markup with no Proxy. Both are stronger than base.
- **Regression risk:** the change is test-only. The last commits to `client-world.js` were LIN-4279 and LIN-4280. The new code adds to `clickOn` without changing it: the default `target = element` keeps every existing caller's behaviour.
- **Is this a one-off?** No. Its siblings are the remaining 12 hand-written-fake files on the census, and pieces 2–6 (LIN-4308…LIN-4312) already own them. The loader gaps are the shared part of that class, which is why the 21:35 call put their fixes here.

### Findings
1. **Two of the four loader fixes from the person's 21:35 call are not in this piece.** The call said to fix them in this piece so pieces 2–6 inherit them. The implementer followed the call's own "stop and say which suite" clause for #1:
   - **#1 (`window` as the global):** held back because `observation-ruling-delivery.test.js:177` stubs bare `relativeTime` before the real `common.js` runs at `:210`, and `common.js:575` overwrites it. No ruling exists for LIN-4307 or LIN-4254 (I checked `/rulings?includeResolved=true`). Piece 2 (LIN-4308, `common.js` slices) is the next consumer, so leaving this open means piece 2 either bridges it per suite, which the call forbids, or stalls.
   - **#4 (`laneNode` export):** deferred to LIN-4310. But LIN-4310's description and comments don't mention `laneNode` or the new `window` global, so the deferral currently lives only in comments on LIN-4307 and LIN-4254.
2. **`lin-3254` draws its run card by hand (`RUN_CARD`), but a server renderer exists.** That renderer is `renderRun` in `lib/render-session.js:201-215`, reached through the exported `renderSessionPage`. The hand-drawn card has already drifted from it in three ways:
   - it uses `<div class="sess-run">` where the server emits `<li>`;
   - it uses `.sess-proposal-text` and `.sess-reply-text`, which no renderer emits (the real ones are `.sess-proposal-prompt` and the reply `textarea`);
   - its head lacks `role="button"` and `tabindex`.

   Plan rule 3 ("markup comes from the server's real renderer where one exists … or the fixture drifts the way the stub did") covers this, and the base stub was a document router (`querySelectorAll('.sess-run') → [run]`). The selector logic is still pinned, since the mutations go red. But it is pinned over markup the page never produces.
3. **Minor:** home-description writes the `.details` wrapper by hand (`<div class="details" data-details-for=… data-section="">`). The server renders it at `lib/render.js:795/802`. This is acceptable as written because it holds only id and section, but the comment ("as the client does on expand") is the only witness for it.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (LIN-4307's bounded class: the 21:35 call's loader fixes, "in this piece"): `loadWorld`'s `window` is still a copy. Nothing pins that a script's `window.X` is visible to a later script's bare `X`. To settle it before the merge, there are two options:
  - **Do it here:** flip the loader, reorder `observation-ruling-delivery`'s `relativeTime` stub to after `common.js` (or pass it through `globals` after load), and pin it in `client-world.test.js` with `window.X = 1` in script A and bare `X === 1` in script B. That test is red today and should go green.
  - **Drop it from this piece:** this needs the person's explicit ruling, recorded on LIN-4254, naming which piece takes it.
- **Inside** (same class, fix #4): `laneNode` is not exported. To settle it before the merge, there are two options:
  - **Do it here:** export it.
  - **Explicitly re-scope it to LIN-4310** with the person's agreement, and write it into LIN-4310's description: "export `laneNode` from `public/live-console.js` (new `window` global); consumer `task-page-link-client-surfaces`". Neither is done now.
- **Inside** (plan rule 3, real-renderer markup): `lin-3254`'s `RUN_CARD` should come from `renderSessionPage`. Use one session, one loop with a `loopId`, `canReply: true`, and one `proposals` entry for that run, then `parse` and select `.sess-run`. The click targets become `.sess-proposal-prompt` and `.sess-inline-reply textarea`. To settle it before the merge, the same three `session.js:88` mutations must still go red on the real markup.

### Verdict
**Needs Discussion.** The four moved suites are solid: names are kept, every guarding test goes red under mutation, and CI is green. What's open is a scope decision only the person can make. The 21:35 call put loader fixes #1 and #4 in this piece, and it is the person's call whether they stay here or move.

DECISION: Should LIN-4307 (piece 1) make `loadWorld`'s `window` the real global object now, which means reordering `observation-ruling-delivery.test.js`'s `relativeTime` stub (`:177`) to after `common.js` (`:210`)? Or should it merge without that, with the fix moved to piece 2 (LIN-4308)? Separately, may the `laneNode` export move to LIN-4310?
- **Recommendation:** do #1 here. It is a one-suite, test-only reorder that keeps that suite's intent (its stub is meant to win over `common.js`'s). LIN-4308's `common.js` slices are exactly the scripts that need it, and the call's rule was "fix once in the shared helper, in this piece". Accept the `laneNode` move to LIN-4310, since its only consumer is there, provided it is written into LIN-4310's description. Also swap `lin-3254`'s `RUN_CARD` for `renderSessionPage` markup in the same pass.
- **Next action after the ruling:** `implementation` on LIN-4307 (same PR #2322), then review again.

Do #1 in LIN-4307: move observation-ruling-delivery's relativeTime stub after common.js and pin it in client-world.test; move laneNode to LIN-4310 (write it into LIN-4310's description); swap lin-3254's hand-drawn card for renderSessionPage markup

— Ruling recorded via Harbour

Fix that suite's stub order (stub after common.js runs)

— Ruling recorded via Harbour

**Decision applied ("fix that suite's stub order"): `loadWorld`'s `window` is now the global object.** It is on PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2322, commit `e04de9b7`.

- **Loader:** the sandbox is the window, so a script's `window.X = …` is the bare `X` a later script reads. This is pinned by two new cases in `client-world.test.js`.
- **The one suite it changed:** `observation-ruling-delivery.test.js` now stubs `escapeHtml` and `relativeTime` after the real `common.js` runs, not before. `common.js` defines both on `window`, so a stub set earlier is replaced. Its 204 test names are unchanged.
- **Witnesses:** with the window as a copy again, the pins fail; with the stubs before `common.js` again, the banner test fails.
- **Results:** all 47 `loadWorld` suites pass (1,090). `test:hermetic:keyed` passes 23,839 of 23,839.

`laneNode` is still deferred to LIN-4310, the only piece that uses it. CI is running on the new commit; the result will follow.

**Follow-up to the ruling (the `fix-here` option) is done on PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2322, now at head `6be35a30`.**

1. **`window` is the global object.** This is commit `e04de9b7`, pushed by a parallel session while I was doing the same change. My version was the same, so I kept theirs. `loadWorld` defines the window stubs and `globals` on the sandbox, and `sandbox.window = sandbox`. `observation-ruling-delivery`'s `escapeHtml` and `relativeTime` stubs now go on after `common.js` runs. Two tests in `client-world.test.js` pin the new behaviour, and I checked that both go red with the old separate-copy loader. Of the 46 `loadWorld` suites, only `observation-ruling-delivery` was affected by the change.
2. **`lin-3254` runs over the server's run page.** This is commit `6be35a30`. The card now comes from `renderSessionPage`: one run the owner can reply to, with a pending proposal and its reply box. The hand-drawn `RUN_CARD` is gone. The click targets are `.sess-proposals .sess-proposal-prompt` and the reply box's `[data-testid="session-inline-reply-thread"]`. I re-ran three mutations on the real markup and each turns its test red:
   - `session.js:88` without `.sess-proposals`;
   - `session.js:88` without `.sess-inline-reply`;
   - `toggleRun` without its `aria-expanded` write.
3. **The `laneNode` export is moved to LIN-4310** and written into that issue's description. The new section names `public/live-console.js:1239`, the new `window` global, and the `LANE_CONTENTS` copy in `live-console-world.js` that the export should replace. It also notes that fix #1 has landed, so piece 4 adds no per-suite bridge.

**Tests:** the full unit suite passes on the combined tree (23,839 pass, 0 fail), including `fake-dom-census` and `claude-md-line-budget`. Test names are unchanged apart from the two new `client-world` pins. CI on `6be35a30` is still running; I'll post the result here.

**Next:** review again.
CI on PR #2322 at head `6be35a30` is green: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and CI success all pass (run 42186141544). The PR is MERGEABLE. Next: review again.

CI on PR #2322 (https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2322) is green at head `6be35a30`: Unit tests, all four E2E shards, Secret scan, and CI success. Mergeable (CLEAN). Note: `6be35a30` ("lin-3254 runs over the server's run page, not a hand-drawn card") was pushed to this branch by another session after my `e04de9b7`. I did not write it; it only changes `lin-3254-session-run-toggles.test.js`, and CI includes it.

## Review — LIN-4307

Re-review of PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2322 at head `6be35a30`, following the ruling of 08:07. Merge-base is `165c61e7`, which is current `origin/main`. Since the last review (`fbd00503`) there are two new commits: `e04de9b7` (window is the global) and `6be35a30` (lin-3254 over server markup). Both are test-only and touch 4 files: `client-world.js`, `client-world.test.js`, `observation-ruling-delivery.test.js` and `lin-3254-session-run-toggles.test.js`.

CI: green on `6be35a30`. Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and CI success all pass. The PR is MERGEABLE.

### The ruling, item by item
1. **`window` is the global object. Done.** `loadWorld` now defines the window stubs and then `globals` on the sandbox, and sets `sandbox.window = sandbox`. `copyByDescriptor` is gone, but descriptor copying is kept, so a throwing `localStorage` getter is still not read at copy time. `observation-ruling-delivery` now sets its `escapeHtml` and `relativeTime` stubs after `common.js` runs. This was the only suite the change affected, and it is the fix the ruling chose.
2. **`laneNode` moved to LIN-4310. Done.** LIN-4310's description now has a section titled "Moved here from piece 1". It names `public/live-console.js:1239`, the new `window` global as a production change, and the `LANE_CONTENTS`/`makeLaneNode` copy that the export replaces.
3. **`lin-3254` runs on real markup. Done.** The run card now comes from `renderSessionPageOf`, which wraps the real `lib/render-session.js` `renderSessionPage` (`tests/fixtures/cost-read-cores.js:13,77`). It is not a copied fixture. The targets are `.sess-proposal-prompt` (render-session.js:171) and `[data-testid="session-inline-reply-thread"]` (render-session.js:137), inside the server's `<li class="sess-run">`. Each lookup is asserted to exist, so if the markup drifts the test fails loudly instead of passing vacuously. This resolves last review's finding 2.

### What I re-ran myself
- **Full unit suite** (`tests/unit/*.test.js`, `eval-dense`, `code-shape`, with dummy keys) in separate worktrees:
  - head: 23,839 pass, 0 fail;
  - base `origin/main`: 23,834 pass, 0 fail.
  - The sorted-name diff only adds names: 5 new `client-world.test.js` tests and their 2 `describe`s. Nothing is removed or renamed. `fake-dom-census` and `claude-md-line-budget` are green.
- **Mutations on head.** Each one went red, and each was reverted (`git status` clean):
  - `sandbox.window` set back to a separate descriptor copy → both window-global pins red. `fireDOMContentLoaded` also went red.
  - The `observation-ruling-delivery` stubs moved back before `common.js` → "a standing suggestion renders the banner … formatted suggestedAt" red.
  - `session.js:88` without `.sess-proposals` → lin-3254 test 1 red.
  - `session.js:88` without `.sess-inline-reply` → test 2 red.
  - `toggleRun` without the `aria-expanded` write → test 2 red.
  - `session.js:88` with only `button, a[href], textarea` → both red. This shows the new click targets aren't excluded on their own, as the test's comment claims.
- **Regression risk.** A `window` stub whose name matches a default (for example `fetch`) now replaces the default for bare reads, where before it did not. That is the browser model the ruling asked for. All 45 `loadWorld` suites pass with no change to their names.
- **Isolated, or one of a class?** Unchanged from the last review. The remaining hand-written-fake files belong to pieces 2–6 (LIN-4308…LIN-4312), and they now inherit the shared-helper fixes. No per-suite bridge was added.

Last review's minor finding 3 (home-description's hand-written `.details` wrapper, holding only id and section) is still minor and does not block.

### What CI Did Not Prove
CI covers the deliverable; ledger empty. The change is test-only: the shared test loader plus four suites. CI runs everything it changes, and I re-ran the suite and the mutations myself, as listed above.

### Verdict
Approve. All three items in the 08:07 ruling are done and witnessed by mutation. Test names are kept, the census falls from 22 to 18, and CI is green on `6be35a30`. Ready for `close-out`.

## Close-out — LIN-4307

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2322, squashed to `main` as `f73f1b11`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 6be35a30` (the exact head the 08:24 review approved).

**CI:** read fresh before the merge. `.github/workflows/test.yml` exists and its checks on `6be35a30` were all SUCCESS: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source) and CI success. The PR was MERGEABLE/CLEAN.

**Review verdict:** Approve at `6be35a30`, ledger explicitly empty, so there was nothing to settle.

**Changes I made after approval:** none. No fixes were outstanding. The review's three ruling items were already in the approved head: `e04de9b7` (`window` is the global, `observation-ruling-delivery` stub order), `6be35a30` (`lin-3254` over `renderSessionPage`) and the `laneNode` write-up on LIN-4310.

**Ledger:** empty, so no inside or outside items. The review's finding 3 was a minor note and did not block: `lin-4024-home-description` writes the `.details` wrapper by hand, and it holds only id and section. I did not file it. It is a comment-accuracy nit on a fixture, not a defect.

**Post-deploy:** none. The change is test-only (the shared test loader plus four suites), so nothing deploys and no post-deploy step or live check applies.

**Related tickets:** LIN-4308 (piece 2) is blocked by this piece and is now unblocked; it inherits the `window`-global and `clickDelegated` fixes. LIN-4310 already carries the `laneNode` export. LIN-4254 stays open for pieces 2–6, so I left it alone.

**Follow-ups filed:** none, since there were no outside items.

**Description:** the pre-prune description was archived (`/brief?noRefresh=1`) and the snapshot was verified in `/snapshots` (captured 2026-11-06T08:25:43Z, full 5,051-character description). I then replaced the discharged slice and the 21:35 loader-call sections with a short stub. Problem statement, acceptance, rules, parent link and the session-fit and plan-review lines are kept word for word.

issue.title: LIN-4254 piece 0: probe the auto-vivifiers and make the census compute the fake-dom consumer list
